concerns.text: Task T013e is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the sole task covering Constitution Principle VI (Electrophysiological Signal Integrity) and FR-006 (Spike sorting validation report). Without this task, the spec requirement to 'document artifact rejection criteria' and generate 'data/processed/spike_sorting_validation_report.md' is unimplemented.

Task T017 (Real data loader) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the only task implementing the 'Real data from verified sources' constraint and the 'NO synthetic fallback' requirement for production runs. Missing this task leaves the project unable to fetch real data from OpenNeuro/Zenodo as required by the spec.

Task T018 (CLI argument parser) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is required to enforce the 'CI-only synthetic data' constraint and manage data source selection. Without this, the pipeline cannot be orchestrated to distinguish between CI and production environments as mandated by the plan.

Task T034 (Orchestration) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the only task responsible for chaining Ingestion -> Validation -> Modeling -> Visualization. Without this, the 'Integration & Orchestration' phase of the plan is missing, and the pipeline cannot run end-to-end.

Task T005 (Synthetic data generator) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is required for the 'Foundational' phase to generate CI test data. The plan explicitly lists 'Implement synthetic data generator' as a blocking prerequisite for user stories.

Task T006 (Dataset schema) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It defines the input contract `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`. The plan lists 'Define data and output schemas' as a foundational step. Without this, T005 and T011 cannot validate inputs.

Task T007 (Output schema) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It defines `contracts/output.schema.yaml`. The plan lists 'Define data and output schemas' as a foundational step. Missing this breaks the output contract traceability.

Task T010 (Integration test for US1) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the only task verifying the 'data alignment' acceptance criteria for US1. Without it, the 'Independent Test' for US1 is missing.
Task T020 (Permutation test unit test) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the only task verifying the 'null data' scenario for US2. Without it, the 'Independent Test' for US2 is incomplete.

Task T030 (Visual regression test) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is the only task verifying the 'output image exists' and 'SSIM > 0.95' criteria for US3. Without it, the 'Independent Test' for US3 is missing.

Task T038a (Edge case tests) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It covers 'zero-reward trials' and 'silent neurons' which are explicit acceptance criteria for US1. Missing this leaves edge cases untested.
Task T038b (Validation logic tests) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It covers FR-007 and FR-009 validation logic. Without this, the critical data quality checks are not unit-tested.
Task T039 (Quickstart validation) is marked as incomplete ([ ]). It is required to verify the 'quickstart.md' workflow, a standard deliverable for the 'Polish' phase.

Task T002c is marked as [X] (complete) but the comment says 'FAILED: unspecified'. This is a stale status tag. The task should be marked [ ] or [~] if it failed, or the comment should be removed if it was a false alarm.

Task T013f is marked as [~] (in progress) but the description implies it generates a JSON report. If the report is not yet generated, the task is not complete. The status should be [ ] if the artifact is missing.
Task T015 is marked as [~] (in progress). If the error handling for missing metadata is not implemented, the task is incomplete. The status should be [ ] if the code is missing.
Task T016 is marked as [~] (in progress). If the logging for data loss metrics is not implemented, the task is incomplete. The status should be [ ] if the code is missing.
Task T030 is marked as [~] (in progress). If the visual regression test is not implemented, the task is incomplete. The status should be [ ] if the code is missing.
